description:
Read a venue's public booking profile: what it is, where it is, what can be booked, and what time it is THERE right now. Call this first once you have a slug (find_venues turns a name or suburb into one): the other tools need it, and appointment searches need a service id from here.

A detail the business has not entered (industry, address, phone) is left out and listed under `notProvided`; do not guess it. For a restaurant with an online party limit, `groupEnquiry` is where a larger party goes.

Returns `venueClock`, which is the venue's own current date and time. Every date you ask for later is resolved against `venueClock.today`, not against your own today: the two are routinely different days. Times are given as text on purpose and there is no timezone identifier anywhere in the result, because converting them is how a booking ends up hours off.

slug.description: The venue's booking slug, exactly as find_venues or get_venue returned it or as it appears in the venue's own booking link: the last path segment of gaplessly.com/book/<slug>, or the first label of <slug>.gaplessly.com. Not the business name; use find_venues to turn a name into a slug.

venue.description: Alias of `slug`, kept for existing clients. Send `slug`.

name: get_venue
title: Look up a venue
